fusions.name: Plumb Shot
fusions.desc: Fires a weighted line that deals 9 damage. Each kill returns a charge, up to 4.

fusions.name: Scattershot Web
fusions.desc: Looses a burst of strands in a cone, dealing 30 damage to everything caught in it. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Tripwire Charge
fusions.desc: Conjures a trap onto the nearest enemy. It waits 20 seconds, and the first enemy to come within 3 tiles takes 30 damage in a blast around it.

fusions.name: Reload
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, your next spell deals 50% more damage. Once every 10 seconds.
